say:1:1710364001:1.text: Peggy!!! Are you alright? Did you get hurt?
say:1:1710364001:1.source_cn: 佩吉！佩吉！你没事吧？！有没有受伤？

say:3:1710364002:1.text: Hmph, enough fussing, Rowan. I'm not that soft.
say:3:1710364002:1.source_cn: 哼，大惊小怪。罗万，你可别小看我。就凭这些把戏，怎么可...

say:4:1710364003:1.text: Ah, yes, Princess Peggy is the mightiest in all of Savannah.
say:4:1710364003:1.source_cn: 是是是，我忘记了，佩吉公主可是赛凡纳一霸，最厉害了。

say:5:1710364004:1.text: ... You must've been worried sick while I was gone, right?
say:5:1710364004:1.source_cn: ……倒是你。我不在的时候，你是不是急得团团转，到处找我啊？

say:6:1710364005:1.text: N-Not at all... I just didn't want any complications for my business! Yeah, that's it!
say:6:1710364005:1.source_cn: 我、我哪有担心你……我那是担心商会的生意受影响！对，就...

say:8:1710364007:0.text: Don't even get me started. I was at the Consortium HQ, discussing how to rescue you—I mean, all of you—with Magister Merlin and Gwyneth.
say:8:1710364007:0.source_cn: 别提了。我先是在秘银总部，跟梅林阁下和格温妮丝商量着怎...
say:8:1710364007:0.male: Don't even get me started. I was at the Consortium HQ, discussing how to rescue you—I mean, all of you—with Magister Merlin and Gwyneth.
say:8:1710364007:0.female: Don't even get me started. I was at the Consortium HQ, discussing how to rescue you—I mean, all of you—with Magister Merlin and Gwyneth.

say:9:1710364008:0.text: Then I had to step away to handle some work. After I finished signing some documents and was about to head back to them... everything went blurry, and I ended up here!
say:9:1710364008:0.source_cn: 然后就被生意绊住了手脚，我刚签完字，正准备回去找他们汇...

say:10:1710364009:1.text: ... Figures, you can't be trusted when it matters most.
say:10:1710364009:1.source_cn: 这都是什么啊……果然你这家伙关键时刻靠不住。

say:12:1710364010:1.text: Aww, you lovebirds are so sweet!
say:12:1710364010:1.source_cn: 哎呀，虽然出场方式狼狈了点，但这情谊，真是让我们这些老...

say:13:1710364011:0.text: Ah, it's so great to be young!
say:13:1710364011:0.source_cn: 哎呦——可不是嘛！年轻真好！

say:14:1710364012:0.text: Wow, it's packed in here! Viscount Urswick, Madam Alaine, Countess Caloren, and the Chief Justice?!
say:14:1710364012:0.source_cn: 哇！这里怎么那么多人！乌瑟斯子爵、阿莱茵馆长、凯洛伦夫...

say:15:1710364013:0.source_cn: 啊，还有亨德里克司令？！您真的在这里！

say:16:1710364014:1.text: Gwyneth was beside herself when she found out you were missing!
say:16:1710364014:1.source_cn: 刚才在秘银商会，格温妮丝发现您失踪的时候，简直急疯了！

say:18:1710364015:0.text: Gwyneth... I feel bad for putting my daughter through that.
say:18:1710364015:0.source_cn: 格温妮丝……是我让她担心了。身为父亲，却让女儿如此焦急...

say:19:1710364016:1.text: Anyway, the situation's getting worse, with more people likely to be sent in.
say:19:1710364016:1.source_cn: 不过，既然罗万少爷此时也被传送进来，这意味着有可能会有...

say:21:1710364017:1.text: We need to get out fast and find the truth. With King Rolan's coffin before us, the secret passage can't be far.
say:21:1710364017:1.source_cn: 嗯，当务之急是尽快离开，去外面弄清真相。幸好我们现在正...

say:22:1710364018:0.text: I first stumbled on this passage when I was little... Now that I'm bigger and taller, I'll need some time to find the switch.
say:22:1710364018:0.source_cn: 但我发现那条路的时候还很小……我是从柱子和雕像的缝隙钻...

say:24:1710364020:1.text: It's been an exhausting journey for everyone. Why don't we rest here for a while and wait for Princess Peggy?
say:24:1710364020:1.source_cn: 既然如此，诸位大人一路走来，体力消耗很大。不如在此稍作...

say:25:1710364021:1.text: You make a good point. Everyone, take a fifteen-minute rest here. Rowan, come with me!
say:25:1710364021:1.source_cn: 亨德里克卿言之有理。大家先原地休息一刻钟。罗万，跟我来这边！

say:27:1710364022:1.text: I'll give the communicator another try then...
say:27:1710364022:1.source_cn: 那我也再试着联络一下梅林大人吧，希望这次能联络上……
say:27:1710364022:1.male: I'll give the communicator another try then...
say:27:1710364022:1.female: I'll give the communicator another try then...

say:30:1710364023:0.text: Cassadee moves to a quiet corner and infuses the communicator with magic.
say:30:1710364023:0.source_cn: 科丝蒂拿着通讯器走向一旁，对着其再次注入魔力。

say:31:1710364024:0.text: To her excitement, the communicator is responding this time!
say:31:1710364024:0.source_cn: 令人兴奋的是，这次通讯器好像有了反应！

say:34:1710364025:0.text: ... Magister Merlin! Can you hear me...
say:34:1710364025:0.male: ... Magister Merlin! Can you hear me...
say:34:1710364025:0.female: ... Magister Merlin! Can you hear me...

narration:35:1710364026:0.text: This is what Peggy and Cassadee have experienced in the Hall of Ancients so far...
narration:35:1710364026:0.source_cn: 这就是佩吉和科丝蒂在圣古堂中遭遇的一切……

say:39:1710364027:0.text: So the Hall of Ancients has become a distorted realm, where time itself flows differently than in the outside world...
say:39:1710364027:0.source_cn: 也就是说，你们身处的圣古堂，不仅是一个发生了异变的空间...

say:40:1710364028:0.text: Father, Rowan, and the other nobles were teleported there.
say:40:1710364028:0.source_cn: 父亲，罗万，还有那些消失的贵族，都是瞬间被传送到了圣古堂。

say:41:1710364029:0.text: Can magic really accomplish all that?
say:41:1710364029:0.source_cn: 梅林阁下，这一切真是魔法能做到的吗？
say:41:1710364029:0.male: Can magic really accomplish all that?
say:41:1710364029:0.female: Can magic really accomplish all that?

choice_prompt:42:1710364029.text: Can magic really accomplish all that?
choice_prompt:42:1710364029.source_cn: 梅林阁下，这一切真是魔法能做到的吗？
choice_prompt:42:1710364029.male: Can magic really accomplish all that?
choice_prompt:42:1710364029.female: Can magic really accomplish all that?

say:43:1710364030:0.text: Your Highness, we've identified a link between all the missing person cases—
say:43:1710364030:0.source_cn: 公主殿下，关于进入圣古堂的线索，我们发现——

say:49:1710364032:1.text: Everyone, stay alert and protect the princess!

narration:51:1710364033:0.text: The light on the communicator flickers out the very next moment.
narration:51:1710364033:0.source_cn: 通讯器上的光芒瞬间熄灭

narration:52:1710364034:0.text: Sounds like Peggy and the others are under attack!
narration:52:1710364034:0.source_cn: 圣古堂内的佩吉她们似乎遭遇了什么袭击——

choice:42:0:1.text: It involves highly advanced spatial magic.
choice:42:0:1.male: It involves highly advanced spatial magic.
choice:42:0:1.female: It involves highly advanced spatial magic.
